positioning.goal: Commercialize the AI Ecommerce Director as a cloud brain plus local connector. Base tools can be opened without recharge; paid value comes from AI/API consumption, data automation, reports, monitoring and strategy work.

business_model.name: AI credit reseller and operations automation
business_model.customer_pricing_principle: Customers recharge platform credits and consume credits when AI models, data automation, report generation, video breakdown or strategy meetings are used.
business_model.margin_principle: Customer-facing prices can follow the public retail/API list price of each AI provider. Owner profit comes from negotiated supplier discounts, volume rebates, enterprise agreements or model-routing optimization.
base_access: read-only store data viewing when data is imported by the customer
metered_access: automated collection jobs run by the platform

data_separation.customer_private_knowledge_base: customer-specific store, product, creator, sales, ad, review and strategy memory
data_separation.public_pattern_library: sanitized reusable platform patterns, video structures, category signals and risk rules
data_separation.global_risk_library: platform rules, IP/TRO/account-risk terms and banned-word intelligence without customer secrets

rules: Every record must carry tenant_id and workspace_id before customer deployment.
A customer can never query another customer's private records.
Global public patterns can only be created from sanitized, non-private, non-secret knowledge.
Reports must show whether the conclusion came from private data, public pattern library, or both.

customer_strategy_controls.goal: Customers can talk to AI and adjust strategy without touching hidden admin settings.
rules: Customer strategy changes affect only their tenant/workspace unless manually promoted to a sanitized global pattern.
Customer can request a strategy change, but high-risk store actions still enter the approval queue.
AI must show whether a recommendation came from customer private data, global pattern library, or platform public data.

owner_platform_jobs: platform policy and risk library updates
data_automation_model.principle: Owner can run shared automation centrally. Customers manually decide what they want monitored, then the platform schedules and charges metered work where applicable.

closed_beta_workflow: Collect authorized or manually uploaded store data.
Generate product, video, listing, creator, ad and risk reports.
Create action queue instead of direct execution.
Update StrategyMemory, LearningEvent, KnowledgeScore and PatternWeight.
Review bugs, data gaps and wrong conclusions daily.
p0_implementation_tasks: Add tenant/workspace/store fields to customer-facing records.
Keep report ownership and audit records in backend only; do not embed visible signatures, model names, agent names or watermark text in customer-facing reports.
Add export-control policy for global and private knowledge.
Add audit records for imports, analysis, report generation, export and approvals.
Split customer private knowledge from sanitized public pattern library.
Keep all real store actions approval-gated during closed beta.
Run daily evidence-quality and bug review before expanding customer access.
